usedFor: Google Analytics measures your site, and HubSpot is the CRM. When “Conversion Event Created” fires in Google Analytics, “Create Deal” in HubSpot can open a deal for it.

bestTemplate.name: “Conversion Event Created” in Google Analytics, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A conversion is the moment worth a deal, and “Create Deal” puts it in the pipeline. “Update Company” needs an existing company, so it suits conversions you can already match.

watchOut: “Conversion Event Created” is polling, so deals appear after the next check. “Create Contact” requires an email and “Update Company” requires a company ID, so check the event gives you them.
